newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway share index lifted by Kvaerner.
newsitem.headline: Norway share index lifted by Kvaerner.

text.p: A strong showing by shares in industrial group Kvaerner helped to lift the Oslo Bourse Total index into positive territory on Tuesday following Monday's drop.
The index closed 0.12 percent higher at 1,102.16 points. Turnover was heavy at 1.6 billion crowns, of which 610 million crowns were traded in another industrial giant, Norsk Hydro .

Kvaerner A shares finished 3.15 percent higher at 343.50 crowns after the company reported annual profits that fell short of expectations. But analysts said the results on a divisional level were encouraging and that
"The underlying operating profit in Kvaerner is showing signs of strengthening," said one analyst.
Hydro, however, fell 1.9 percent to 342.50 crowns in a continuous slide following the release of disappointing 1996 profits on Monday that helped to drag down the Total index.
Analysts had said they expected further losses on Tuesday once foreign investors had digested the figures.
